summary: Configured node1 with a persistent firewalld policy allowing SSH and TCP/8080 while explicitly rejecting unrelated inbound traffic. The policy survived a verified node restart; RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Used the installed, enabled firewalld/nftables stack.
Removed Cockpit and DHCPv6-client allowances from the public zone.
Allowed only SSH and TCP/8080, with an explicit REJECT fallback.
Behaviorally verified ports 22 and 8080 were reachable while a listening service on port 9090 was rejected.
Restarted node1 once and verified its boot ID changed and all required services and firewall behavior recovered.

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP/8080 and rejects unrelated inbound connections
evidence.summary: Runtime and permanent policies allow TCP/22 and TCP/8080 with an explicit reject verdict. Pre- and post-restart ingress tests connected to 22/8080 and rejected 9090.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Before and after configuration/restart, node1 remained RHEL 9.8 with kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64.

Captured healthy baseline and boot ID 9feeb0bb-6fe6-40fb-9831-d869ed07631c; restart was acknowledged; new boot ID a6150076-403d-41fd-965b-a6c2672923e6 was observed; firewalld, sshd, persistent rules, active rules, and expected ingress behavior recovered.
